items.title: Albert Morgan Interview, 1958-08-19
items.q: We had another brother. John Morera. John John. That's right. He used to play with the Tuxedo Band, wasn't it?

ctx.x: We had another brother. John Morera. John John. That's right. He used to play with the Tuxedo Band, wasn't it?
Went to New York and died in the 1940s.
